{"reason":"Replace the alternative-supplier action in the second branch with alert-planner. It costs 35,000 versus 45,000 and always arrives in time, making all 34 switches cheaper while preventing their stockouts. This fixes the failing medium rows (5.3 and 2.8 inventory-days) and should lower the 2,165,000 cost and 4 stockouts without violating the gate.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
